title: Consistent Paths Lead to Truth: Self-Rewarding Reinforcement Learning for LLM Reasoning
authors_zh: Kongcheng Zhang、Qi Yao、Shunyu Liu、Yingjie Wang、Baisheng Lai、Jieping Ye、Mingli Song、Dacheng Tao
paper_type_zh: 自奖励推理强化学习配方
best_for_zh: 关注内在奖励、轨迹评价和奖励攻击审计的研究者
one_line: Converts 16 on-policy trajectories into consistency, volatility, answer-group, and curiosity rewards for Reinforce++ without using correctness labels for optimization.
把 16 条策略轨迹转换为一致性、波动性和好奇心奖励，用于无需外部正确性标签的 Reinforce++。
why: Makes a self-generated reward recipe inspectable while showing why internal consistency must not be conflated with external correctness.
inclusion_reason: Exposes a concrete recipe for turning multiple on-policy reasoning traces into programmatic self-reward without correctness labels, together with important release and audit gaps.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The official NeurIPS proceedings list this work in the NeurIPS 2025 Main Conference Track; the arXiv record was first submitted on 10 June 2025. CoVo addresses a specific bottleneck in reasoning post-training: reinforcement learning normally needs a correctness label, executable checker, reward model, or judge, yet many reasoning prompts have no dependable external verifier. The paper asks whether a policy can obtain a useful learning signal from the geometry of its own sampled reasoning paths. (Paper §1; NeurIPS proceedings)

For each prompt, the current policy produces 16 complete trajectories. A trajectory is divided into intermediate states, and each state is scored by how likely the same policy is to continue toward each distinct final answer sampled by the group. The resulting training object is not a labeled proof or a correctness-verified answer. It is an online collection of prompts, policy traces, extracted answer groups, state-to-answer distance matrices, trajectory statistics, scalar rewards, and normalized advantages. Supervision attaches as one answer-group reward shared by full trajectories, then becomes normalized advantages for Reinforce++ rather than a step-correctness label. (Paper §2–§3; Appendix C)

This boundary matters. CoVo's reward estimates internal consistency and path stability; it does not establish that an answer is true, and Math-Verify enters only during benchmark evaluation. The Card belongs to Data Construction & Open-Release Recipes because the paper and code expose a prompt-to-rollout-to-reward-to-policy pipeline, and to Preference / Reward / Feedback Data because the reusable object is a programmatic scalar feedback contract. It does not cover externally verified RLVR data. The public Hugging Face release contains prompt/reference-answer JSONL files rather than the paper-run trajectories, distance matrices, group rewards, filtered prompts, or policy checkpoints. The bilingual Card is L4_chinese_review_ready, while its partial release status still blocks training-ready reuse.

NeurIPS 官方 proceedings 将本文列入 NeurIPS 2025 Main Conference Track；arXiv 记录的首次提交日期为 2025 年 6 月 10 日。CoVo 针对的是推理后训练中的一个具体瓶颈：强化学习通常需要正确性标签、可执行检查器、reward model 或 judge，但许多推理题并没有可靠的外部 verifier。论文由此考察：policy 能否从自己采样出的多条推理路径的几何结构中产生可用学习信号。（论文 §1；NeurIPS proceedings）

对每个 prompt，当前 policy 生成 16 条完整轨迹。每条轨迹被分成中间状态，再由同一 policy 估计从各状态继续到该组不同最终答案的可能性。实际训练对象不是带标签证明，也不是经正确性验证的答案，而是在线产生的 prompt、policy 轨迹、答案分组、状态到答案距离矩阵、轨迹统计量、标量奖励与归一化 advantage。监督先以答案组奖励附着到完整轨迹，再转成 Reinforce++ 的归一化 advantage，而不是逐步正确性标签。（论文 §2–§3；Appendix C）

这一边界不能混淆：CoVo 估计的是内部一致性与路径稳定性，不能证明答案真实正确；Math-Verify 只出现在 benchmark 评估环节。本卡属于 Data Construction & Open-Release Recipes，因为论文与代码给出了从 prompt、rollout、reward 到 policy 更新的流水线；同时属于 Preference / Reward / Feedback Data，因为可复用对象是一套程序化标量反馈契约。它不属于经外部 verifier 验证的 RLVR 数据。公开 Hugging Face 资源是 prompt/reference-answer JSONL 文件，并未发布论文训练中的轨迹、距离矩阵、分组奖励、过滤提示或 policy checkpoint。双语 Card 已达到 L4_chinese_review_ready，但 partial 发布状态仍阻止其被视为可直接训练复用的发布。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The core signal is built from current-policy likelihoods rather than correctness judgments. A trajectory is split at predefined boundaries such as newlines. For every intermediate prefix and every distinct final answer in the 16-sample group, CoVo computes a length-normalized negative log-likelihood of producing that answer from that prefix. These values form a states-by-candidate-answers distance matrix.

Two trajectory statistics summarize the matrix. Consistency is the fraction of states for which the closest candidate answer is the trajectory's own final answer. Volatility is the normalized position of the last state whose closest candidate is not its own final answer. Trajectories are then grouped by exact extracted final answer. To reduce sensitivity to individual outliers, the reported vector aggregation maps each trajectory to a vector whose magnitude is consistency and whose angle is determined by volatility, sums the vectors within an answer group, and uses the normalized resultant magnitude as the intrinsic group reward.

An optional curiosity term rewards low-probability state transitions, with a KL-based penalty intended to prevent extremely unlikely tokens from dominating. The total scalar reward combines the intrinsic and curiosity terms and is consumed by Reinforce++.

This is a programmatic self-reward mechanism, not an external verifier. Math-Verify appears in the paper only to score benchmark answers against ground truth during evaluation; it is not used to produce CoVo's training reward.

核心信号来自当前策略的似然,而不是正确性判定。一条轨迹会按换行符等预定边界分成多个状态。对每个中间前缀及 16 个样本中每个不同的最终答案,CoVo 计算从该前缀生成该答案的长度归一化负对数似然,从而形成"状态 × 候选答案"距离矩阵。

论文用两个量概括该矩阵。一致性是"最近候选答案与本轨迹最终答案相同"的状态占比;波动性是最后一个最近答案仍与本轨迹答案不同的状态位置,并经归一化。随后按精确抽取的最终答案分组。为降低单个离群轨迹的影响,论文将每条轨迹表示为向量:模长由一致性决定,方向由波动性决定;组内向量求和后,归一化合向量模长即为内在组奖励。

可选的好奇奖励鼓励低概率状态转移,同时使用基于 KL 的惩罚,防止极低概率 token 主导奖励。内在项与好奇项合成标量奖励,再交给 Reinforce++ 优化。

这是一种程序化自奖励机制,不是外部正确性验证器。论文中的 Math-Verify 只在评估阶段根据真值给 benchmark 答案计分,不参与 CoVo 训练奖励的生成。

title: Method
方法
html:
The reported pipeline has four separable layers.

  1. Prompt sourcing. Optimization uses instructions from the Open-Reasoner-Zero training set without their labels. The paper describes the mixture as including AIME through 2023, MATH, NuminaMath, Tulu 3 MATH, OpenR1-Math-220k, other open datasets, and programmatically synthesized tasks. The released records do not preserve per-example source identifiers.
  2. Online construction. The current policy samples 16 trajectories per prompt at temperature 1.0, top-p 1.0, with top-k disabled and a 4096-token maximum in the paper. It splits traces into states, extracts final answers, constructs the distance matrix, computes consistency and volatility, groups exact answers, and optionally adds curiosity.
  3. Optimization. Reinforce++ converts scalar rewards into normalized advantages and applies clipped policy updates. The paper reports learning rate 5e-7, initial KL coefficient 1e-4, rollout batch size 16, train batch size 32, one epoch, and experiments on eight A100-80GB GPUs.
  4. Evaluation. MATH-500, GSM8K, OlympiadBench, AMC 2023, MMLU-Pro, CommonsenseQA, and GPQA measure downstream behavior. Math-Verify checks evaluation answers at temperature 0; it remains outside the training reward.

The public repository implements the recipe on OpenRLHF and exposes switches for answer-unanimity filtering, intrinsic reward variants, and curiosity. Its example Qwen script uses a 2048-token generation limit and leaves curiosity disabled unless the user enables it, so it is a runnable variant rather than an exact manifest of the paper's 4096-token configuration.

论文的流程可分为四层。

  1. 提示来源。 优化仅使用 Open-Reasoner-Zero 训练集中的指令,不使用其标签。论文称混合来源包括截至 2023 年的 AIME、MATH、NuminaMath、Tulu 3 MATH、OpenR1-Math-220k、其他开放数据集及程序合成任务;发布记录没有保留样本级来源标识。
  2. 在线构造。 当前策略对每个提示采样 16 条轨迹。论文设置温度 1.0、top-p 1.0、关闭 top-k,最大生成长度为 4096 token。之后切分状态、抽取答案、建立距离矩阵、计算一致性和波动性、按精确答案分组,并可选地加入好奇奖励。
  3. 策略优化。 Reinforce++ 将标量奖励转换为归一化优势,再进行截断策略更新。论文报告学习率 5e-7、初始 KL 系数 1e-4、rollout batch 16、train batch 32、训练 1 个 epoch,并使用 8 张 A100-80GB GPU。
  4. 效果评估。 评估集包括 MATH-500、GSM8K、OlympiadBench、AMC 2023、MMLU-Pro、CommonsenseQA 和 GPQA。Math-Verify 在温度 0 的评估中检查答案,与训练奖励保持分离。

公开代码基于 OpenRLHF,提供了答案全一致过滤、内在奖励变体和好奇奖励开关。但 Qwen 示例脚本的最大生成长度为 2048 token,而且默认未开启好奇项;它因此是可运行变体,不是论文 4096-token 设置的完整运行清单。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper evaluates CoVo across mathematics, commonsense, and science benchmarks with greedy Pass@1 and Math-Verify, and reports gains for several model/dataset combinations but not universal dominance. For Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, CoVo reaches 68.2 on MATH-500 versus 65.4 for few-shot CoT, 67.4 for GRPO, 67.6 for Reinforce++, and 67.8 for TTRL. On Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, CoVo's 51.2 is below GRPO's 51.8 and Reinforce++'s 51.6 on MATH-500, while it is highest among listed methods on OlympiadBench (19.6), GPQA (32.1), and CommonsenseQA (74.4). Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct results are similarly mixed: CoVo scores 76.8 on MATH-500, but 92.5 on GSM8K versus TTRL's 92.8 and 57.0 on MMLU-Pro versus EMPO's 57.4. (Paper Table 1; Appendix Table 6)

The paper directly tests the proposed proxy. Across MATH-500, MMLU, GPQA, and CommonsenseQA, Table 2 reports correct trajectories with much higher mean consistency (0.787–0.889) than incorrect ones (0.215–0.274), and lower mean volatility (0.227–0.386 versus 0.761–0.867). These are correlations measured with benchmark correctness labels after sampling; they support discrimination in the tested distributions but do not turn the training reward into an external verifier. (Paper Table 2)

Table 3 supplies component evidence. For Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, vector intrinsic reward plus curiosity obtains 68.2/88.7/47.5 on MATH-500/GSM8K/AMC-23; vector intrinsic alone obtains 68.0/88.4/42.5, and curiosity alone obtains 61.8/80.6/32.5. On Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, the corresponding three configurations score 51.2/79.6/25.0, 51.6/79.5/22.5, and 46.2/69.5/15.0. The joint reward is not best on every task, so the ablation supports complementarity more narrowly than a universal improvement claim. CoVo reward calculation also costs 49.22 seconds, or 24.6% of a measured training step, versus 4.38 seconds/2.8% for majority voting and 2.06 seconds/1.3% for ground-truth reward. (Paper Table 3; Appendix Table 8)

These author-reported scores show that the training procedure can change evaluated task accuracy. They do not validate every self-reward, prove prompt quality, demonstrate decontamination, or establish that consistency tracks truth for every item. Evaluation correctness is supplied separately by Math-Verify and benchmark ground truth, and no independent reproduction was found in the verified artifacts.

Artifact evidence is mixed. The official repository contains the OpenRLHF implementation and example training commands. The official Hugging Face repository contains README.md, train.jsonl, and test.jsonl. However, the hosted builder reports a schema-cast failure because the train records use problem and solution, while test records use problem, answer, and level. No released artifact was found for paper-run trajectories, distance matrices, answer groups, rewards, filtered examples, seeds, logs, or checkpoints.

论文用 greedy Pass@1 与 Math-Verify 在数学、常识和科学 benchmark 上评估 CoVo；多个模型/数据组合有提升，但并非全面占优。对 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct，CoVo 在 MATH-500 上得到 68.2，few-shot CoT、GRPO、Reinforce++ 与 TTRL 分别为 65.4、67.4、67.6 和 67.8。对 Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct，CoVo 的 MATH-500 为 51.2，低于 GRPO 的 51.8 和 Reinforce++ 的 51.6，但在列出方法中，其 OlympiadBench、GPQA 与 CommonsenseQA 分别以 19.6、32.1、74.4 居首。Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 结果同样混合：CoVo 的 MATH-500 为 76.8，但 GSM8K 的 92.5 低于 TTRL 的 92.8，MMLU-Pro 的 57.0 低于 EMPO 的 57.4。（论文 Table 1；Appendix Table 6）

论文还直接检验了代理信号。在 MATH-500、MMLU、GPQA 和 CommonsenseQA 上，Table 2 中正确轨迹的平均 consistency 为 0.787–0.889，明显高于错误轨迹的 0.215–0.274；正确轨迹的平均 volatility 为 0.227–0.386，低于错误轨迹的 0.761–0.867。这些是在采样后借助 benchmark 正确性标签得到的相关性，支持代理在受测分布上的区分能力，但不能把训练奖励变成外部 verifier。（论文 Table 2）

Table 3 提供组件证据。对 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct，向量内在奖励加 curiosity 在 MATH-500/GSM8K/AMC-23 上为 68.2/88.7/47.5；仅向量内在奖励为 68.0/88.4/42.5，仅 curiosity 为 61.8/80.6/32.5。对 Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct，三种设置分别为 51.2/79.6/25.0、51.6/79.5/22.5 与 46.2/69.5/15.0。联合奖励并非每个任务都最优，因此消融只能较窄地支持互补性，不能支持普遍提升。CoVo reward 计算每步耗时 49.22 秒，占实测训练步 24.6%；majority voting 为 4.38 秒/2.8%，ground-truth reward 为 2.06 秒/1.3%。（论文 Table 3；Appendix Table 8）

这些作者报告的分数说明训练流程可以改变被测任务准确率，但不能验证每个自奖励、证明 prompt 质量或去污染成效，也不能证明所有样本上的“一致”都等于“正确”。评估正确性另由 Math-Verify 和 benchmark 真值提供；已核验 artifact 中没有找到独立复现。

公开产物的完整度有限。官方代码库提供 OpenRLHF 实现和示例训练命令;官方 Hugging Face 仓库包含 README.md、train.jsonl 与 test.jsonl。但托管的数据构建器报告 schema cast 失败:train 记录的字段为 problem 和 solution,test 记录则为 problem、answer 和 level。尚未发现论文运行对应的轨迹、距离矩阵、答案分组、奖励、被过滤样本、随机种子、日志或检查点。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
CoVo's distinguishing move is to turn intermediate path geometry into a self-reward. Final-answer majority voting treats all trajectories ending in one answer as equivalent; a learned judge imports another model's biases; executable verification is unavailable outside checkable domains. CoVo instead asks whether a trajectory's intermediate prefixes consistently point toward its own sampled final answer and how late the preferred answer changes.

The vector form of answer-group aggregation is also consequential: it combines consistency and volatility while reducing the influence of a single high-scoring outlier. Curiosity supplies an exploration term derived from policy transition probabilities rather than from a teacher.

The novelty is therefore a label-free reward construction recipe over multiple on-policy traces. It is not a new ground-truth annotation source, proof checker, or guarantee that consistent paths are correct. The method remains dependent on the current policy's calibration, candidate-answer coverage, segmentation, and answer extraction.

CoVo 的区分点是将中间路径的几何结构转化为自奖励。仅按最终答案多数投票,会把所有以同一答案结束的轨迹视为等价;学习式裁判器会引入另一个模型的偏差;可执行验证又无法覆盖不可检查领域。CoVo 改为检查:一条轨迹的中间前缀是否持续指向本轨迹的最终答案,以及首选答案直到多晚才稳定。

答案组的向量聚合也是关键设计:它同时编码一致性与波动性,并降低单条高分离群轨迹的影响。好奇项则根据策略的状态转移概率形成探索信号,不需要教师模型。

因而,该工作的新意是一种面向多条 on-policy 轨迹的无标签奖励构造配方,而不是新的真值标注源、证明检查器或"一致必然正确"的保证。它仍依赖当前策略的概率校准、候选答案覆盖、状态切分与答案抽取。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The central validity risk is that internal consistency is only a proxy for truth. A confidently wrong trajectory can remain stable, and several trajectories can share the same misconception. Because distances are computed by the policy being optimized, reward calibration changes with the policy and may amplify its own blind spots.

Implementation choices are part of the reward contract. Newline segmentation changes the state sequence; answer extraction and exact-string grouping can split equivalent answers or merge malformed ones; the set of sampled candidates limits what each state can be compared against. Prompts with all-identical sampled answers provide no comparative signal, so the optional filter can remove both genuinely easy items and items on which the policy fails uniformly. Computing all state-to-answer distances scales as O(NTK) for N trajectories, T states, and K distinct answers.

Reproducibility is partial. The paper reports 4096 generated tokens and uses curiosity in the proposed reward, whereas the public example script uses 2048 and leaves curiosity disabled by default. The public data repository exposes prompt/reference files, not reward-bearing paper runs, and its train/test schemas currently prevent a unified hosted build. Seeds, run manifests, logs, reward matrices, filtered-example lists, and checkpoints are absent. The paper's chronology-based cleanliness argument is not a measured contamination audit, and the dataset-card MIT declaration does not resolve upstream rights or the code license scope.

最核心的有效性风险是:内部一致性只是真实性的代理指标。一条自信但错误的轨迹同样可以很稳定,多条轨迹也可能共享同一误解。而且距离是由正在被优化的策略自身计算的,奖励校准会随策略变化,并可能放大其固有盲点。

实现细节本身就是奖励契约的一部分。换行切分会改变状态序列;答案抽取与精确字符串分组可能把等价答案拆开,或错误合并畸形输出;采样到的候选集限定了每个状态可以比较的范围。所有采样答案都相同的提示没有对比信号,因而可选过滤会同时移除真正容易的题目和策略统一失败的题目。对 N 条轨迹、T 个状态和 K 个不同答案计算全部距离,复杂度为 O(NTK)。

复现性仅属部分开放。论文报告的最大生成长度为 4096 token,且方法包含好奇奖励;公开示例脚本则使用 2048,并默认关闭好奇项。数据仓库只有提示/参考文件,没有带奖励的论文运行记录,而且 train/test schema 当前无法统一构建。随机种子、运行清单、日志、奖励矩阵、过滤样本列表和检查点均未发布。论文基于数据发布时序的"较干净"论证不等于实测污染审计;数据卡上的 MIT 声明也未解决上游权利和代码许可范围。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Data Construction & Open-Release Recipes track, CoVo is useful primarily as a construction recipe rather than as a finished reward dataset. It specifies how to convert a prompt batch and multiple on-policy traces into intermediate data objects: extracted answer candidates, state-to-answer likelihood distances, consistency and volatility measures, answer-group vectors, scalar rewards, and Reinforce++ advantages.

Researchers can use the recipe to compare self-reward designs, study whether path-derived signals correlate with external correctness, test alternative segmentation and semantic answer-equivalence rules, or measure reward drift as the policy changes. The public implementation also makes ablations of filtering, intrinsic aggregation, and curiosity feasible.

Any reuse should preserve three partitions: prompt data, online self-reward records, and benchmark evaluation. The released JSONL files cover only part of the first partition; the second must be regenerated and audited; benchmark labels and Math-Verify belong only to the third. A serious reconstruction should record source IDs, prompt hashes, model and tokenizer revisions, seeds, extraction rules, raw trajectories, candidate groups, distance matrices, component rewards, filters, and checkpoints.

对 数据构造与开放发布配方 轨道而言,CoVo 的主要价值是"构造配方",而不是一个已完工的奖励数据集。它给出了如何将提示批次和多条 on-policy 轨迹转换为一系列中间数据对象:抽取的候选答案、状态到答案的似然距离、一致性和波动性、答案组向量、标量奖励及 Reinforce++ 优势。

研究者可以用这套配方比较不同自奖励设计,检验路径信号与外部正确性的相关性,测试替代状态切分方案和语义等价的答案归并规则,或者跟踪策略变化时的奖励漂移。公开实现也支持对答案全一致过滤、内在聚合方式和好奇项进行消融。

任何复用都应明确分开三类资源:提示数据、在线自奖励记录和 benchmark 评估。当前公开 JSONL 只覆盖第一类的一部分;第二类需重新生成并审计;benchmark 标签和 Math-Verify 只属于第三类。严谨重建时应记录来源 ID、提示哈希、模型与 tokenizer 修订版、随机种子、抽取规则、原始轨迹、候选分组、距离矩阵、分量奖励、过滤决定与检查点。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• CoVo samples 16 trajectories per prompt and derives reward from current-policy state-to-answer likelihoods; no correctness label is used for optimization.
  • Consistency, volatility, exact-answer grouping, vector aggregation, and optional curiosity produce a full-episode scalar reward for Reinforce++.
  • The signal is self-reward, not a truth verifier. Math-Verify and benchmark ground truth are evaluation-only components.
  • Benchmark gains are mixed evidence about downstream behavior, not proof of reward correctness, prompt quality, or decontamination.
  • The code is public, but paper-run traces and rewards are absent; the example script diverges from paper settings, and the released train/test JSONL schemas currently fail to build together.

• CoVo 对每个提示采样 16 条轨迹,根据当前策略的"状态到答案"似然构造奖励,优化过程不使用正确性标签。
  • 一致性、波动性、精确答案分组、向量聚合与可选好奇项共同产生供 Reinforce++ 使用的整轨迹标量奖励。
  • 这是自奖励,不是真实性验证器;Math-Verify 与 benchmark 真值只用于评估。
  • benchmark 提升仅是下游行为证据,不能证明奖励正确、提示高质量或去污染有效。
  • 代码已开放,但论文运行的轨迹和奖励未发布;示例脚本与论文设置有差异,且当前发布的 train/test JSONL schema 无法一起构建。
